gcp-E2-f_0._gcloud_instance_doc: MUST match the GCP instance name EXACTLY as `gcloud compute instances list` reports it — it is passed verbatim to `gcloud compute instances start/reset/get-serial-port-output`. This said "arch-1" until 2026-08-12, long after the instance was replaced by one named gcp-proxy (the terraform.json description still reads 'replacement for arch-1'). Nothing caught it because every consumer that matters is a control-plane call that only runs during an incident: normal operation goes over SSH via ssh_alias and never touches this field. It surfaced when gcp-proxy wedged and devops.vm.reset returned "The resource 'projects/diegonmarcos-infra-prod/zones/us-central1-a/instances/arch-1' was not found" — i.e. the recovery tool was broken at exactly the moment it was needed, and recovery had to be done by hand from the console. Verified against live GCP: name=gcp-proxy, zone=us-central1-a, e2-micro, NAT_IP 35.226.147.64, which matches .ip above.

wireguard.port_fallback_description: Hub-side NAT redirect (deployed Phase 4 via firewall.nix): udp/443 → udp/51820 on gcp-proxy. Clients on networks blocking udp/51820 (airports, hotels) switch to this port.

vault-backup._doc: Dedicated peer slot for the cloud-vault vault-db-backup workflow. Kept separate from gha-runner so a nightly backup never contends with a ship run for a peer slot. Private key lives in cloud-vault A0_keys/providers/wireguard/vault-backup/ and as the WG_PRIVATE_KEY secret on diegonmarcos/cloud-vault.

native._wireguard_public_moved_doc: wg-public mesh topology + client list MOVED OUT of config.json. New source of truth: a_solutions/infra-net_wireguard-public/build.json (top-level wireguard_public block). Adding/rotating/sharing a wg-public client is a single-file edit there — keeps the global root config focused on cross-cutting topology (vms, wg0, dns, docker, monitoring) and not on individual access-control rows. Consolidator engine: 1_cloud-configs/src/derive/cloud-data-config-consolidated.ts reads from the new build.json first, falls back to config.json::wireguard_public only if the build.json is missing (transitional). Once tested + verified, the fallback can be removed. Server-side peer pubkeys still come from vault/A0_keys/providers/wireguard/<name>-public/publickey.

docker.description: Docker bridge subnet, iptables managed by firewall.nix

protection._doc: Cross-VM defaults for the vm-pilot protection stack (load-shedder, tier1-apps watchdog, health-agent fd/wg checks, watchdog-petter disk/docker). Per-VM overrides live in b_infra/nixhm-sudo-<alias>/build.json .protection. Consumed (data-driven, never hardcoded in Nix) by: protection/load-shedder.nix, protection/tier1-apps.nix, protection/watchdog.nix, agents/health-agent.nix via consolidated._home_manager.vms.<alias>.protection merged over native.protection. Edit here + redeploy to retune.
